about:
Murray Plastics operates from Gainesville, Georgia, as a founder-led United States manufacturer specializing in custom plastic injection molding. The company does not publish a founding year, but its about page references decades of collective experience among its team of engineers and industry experts.

The shop offers injection molding, mold building, and design and engineering services under one roof. Its facility is described as state-of-the-art, though no square footage or employee count is disclosed. Murray Plastics works with numerous plastic materials, including eco-friendly options, and assists customers with material selection for each project.

The company serves a broad range of industries, though it does not list specific sectors publicly. It emphasizes long-standing customer relationships and a commitment to being a competitive source for American-made plastic parts.

Murray Plastics says its differentiator is personable, down-to-earth service that comes from founder-led ownership, along with in-house mold building and engineering support that helps clients improve product designs. The homepage notes that the team works side-by-side with clients, providing insight and new ideas for better products.
